name: Reel to try list
summary: A food reel someone shared becomes the group's to-try list, with stars for places you've been.
useWhen: someone shares a restaurant or food reel and says 'we should go'
the group keeps a list of places to try and rates them after
dontUseWhen: picking one place for tonight (use a poll or wheel)
a recipe reel to cook together (use reel-cook-night)

params.reel: the shared reel: from (name), note, account, caption, likes, place, area
params.spots: places already on the list: name, area, tried ('Oct 3' or ''), ratings [{by, stars}], want [names]
